style: photorealistic live-action footage, natural warm daylight colours

background.appearance: An empty open savanna field of short dry golden grass under a clear pale-blue sky, a line of distant low acacia trees and bushes on the horizon, soft warm afternoon sunlight.

environment.description: Open savanna with short dry golden grass, distant acacia tree line, clear sky, warm afternoon sunlight, photorealistic.

E.label: lion
E.appearance: an adult male lion with tawny golden fur and a thick dark-brown mane, sitting upright on its haunches, facing the camera

E.label: chicken
E.appearance: a brown hen chicken with reddish-brown feathers, a red comb and wattles, and yellow legs, standing in side profile facing screen left

D.why: The chicken must stay nearer the camera at about half the lion's distance, slightly left so it only partly overlaps the lion.
Camera distance keeps both animals above 15% of the frame height.

text.scene: A fixed, eye-level camera looks across an open savanna of short golden grass on a sunny afternoon. In the centre of the frame, farther away, a tawny adult male lion with a dark-brown mane sits upright on its haunches facing the camera, filling about 30% of the frame height. In the foreground, closer to the camera and slightly left of centre and lower in the frame, a brown hen chicken with a red comb stands in side profile facing screen left, about 24% of the frame height, partly blocking the lower-left part of the lion's front legs; the lion is behind the chicken, farther away and partly hidden behind it.
timeline: The tawny maned lion sits upright on its haunches in the centre, behind the brown hen chicken, farther away and partly hidden behind it; the brown hen chicken stands in the foreground slightly left of centre, closer to the camera, partly blocking the lion's front legs, and looks around.

The tawny maned lion keeps sitting calmly behind the brown hen chicken, farther away and partly hidden behind it, breathing and blinking; the brown hen chicken keeps standing in the foreground, closer to the camera, partly blocking the lion's front legs, turning its head slightly.
constraints: Exactly one lion and exactly one chicken.
The lion stays sitting behind the chicken (farther from the camera) for the whole shot.
The lion does not stand up, walk or attack; neither animal leaves the frame.
No people, no other animals, no on-screen text.

intent.expressiveness_reason: The proxies fix the depth order and screen placement of the lion behind the chicken; the lion's sitting pose is carried only by text.

notes: Lion at 6 m, chicken at 3 m (half the distance), chicken offset 0.25 m left so it overlaps only the lion's lower-left part. Camera at 0.6 m height, eye level for the animals.
